newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING weighs Merrill bid for McIntosh.
newsitem.headline: ING weighs Merrill bid for McIntosh.

text.p: Financial services group Internationale Nederlanden Groep NV (ING) said on Tuesday it was considering Merrill Lynch & Co Inc's bid for Australian brokerage firm McIntosh Securities Ltd.
"We are considering the offer and will let Merrill Lynch know our position on it," an ING spokesman said.
ING holds a 20 percent stake in McIntosh.

Merrill Lynch has offered A$1.40 per share for McIntosh, valuing the company at about A$117 million. The offer represents a premium of about 48 percent over McIntosh's average closing price over the last 30 days.
McIntosh shares closed at A$1.25 on Friday. The shares were suspended on Monday and Tuesday morning pending the announcement of Merrill Lynch's offer. They closed at A$1.38 on Tuesday.
The bid is subject to 90 percent share acceptance and McIntosh has said its directors have unanimously recommended that shareholders accept the offer.
